name: When is the best time to install outdoor lighting during a larger renovation project?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to install outdoor lighting during a larger renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: For optimal integration and efficiency, outdoor lighting is best planned and installed as an integral part of a larger outdoor living space renovation or whole-home remodel. Coordinating lighting installation alongside hardscaping, patio construction, or outdoor kitchen development allows for seamless wiring concealment and strategic fixture placement. This integrated approach, a hallmark of AKN Design Group's design-build process, prevents potential rework and ensures that all elements of your project harmonize effectively, enhancing both functionality and beauty.
acceptedAnswer.description: Outdoor lighting is best installed as part of a larger outdoor living space renovation to ensure seamless integration and efficiency with other construction elements.
